-4.6% day-over-day move (z-score -4.72) on 2020-08-11. Reasons given by 5 reports from that day:
- "Gold Price today August 11 2020 Gold Futures Slump 2 Per Cent As Global Equity Markets , Dollar Rise" (ndtv.com, 2020-08-11). Reported move: down 2%. Reason: Global equity markets rise and dollar rise. Quote: "Gold Price today August 11 2020 Gold Futures Slump 2 Per Cent As Global Equity Markets , Dollar Rise" (source: b16b0dbf22c7a1f2)
- "Gold Settles Sharply Lower , Records Steepest Fall In 9 Years" (finanznachrichten.de, 2020-08-11). Reported move: down 4.6%. Reason: hopes about U.S. coronavirus stimulus and news about Russia registering the first vaccine. Quote: "as riskier assets such as equities rallied on hopes about U.S. coronavirus stimulus and on news about Russia registering the first vaccine against the coronavirus pandemic." (source: 9be7b5e7d8bc7a8b)
- "S & P Futures Hit All Time Highs On Stimulus , Vaccine Hopes ; Gold , Silver Tumble" (zerohedge.com, 2020-08-11). Reported move: down, size not stated. Reason: Stimulus , Vaccine Hopes. Quote: "On Stimulus , Vaccine Hopes" (source: fd9cd2af1e5f0b31)
- "gold rate gold and silver prices decline strongly know gold which price sold in bullion market today vwt | Gold Rate : सोना - चांदी के भाव में भारी गिरावट , जानिए सर्राफा बाजार में आज क्या रहा सोना का भाव ..." (prabhatkhabar.com, 2020-08-11). Reported move: down, size not stated. Reason: रुपये में सुधार आने के कारण सोने में तेजी पर कुछ अंकुश लगा रहा. Quote: "रुपये में सुधार आने के कारण सोने में तेजी पर कुछ अंकुश लगा रहा" (source: 6cd98474bde8704e)
- "Gold Prices Plunge Below $2000 After Explosive Rally" (oilprice.com, 2020-08-11). Reported move: down 4.5%. Reason: dollar clung to gains and risk appetite was boosted by an expected US stimulus deal. Quote: "dollar clung to gains and risk appetite was boosted by an expected US stimulus deal" (source: 774bb276d9e851e3)
Pointing the other way, 1 report from that day:
- "Gold Price Analysis : XAU / USD retraces biggest losses in seven years above $1 , 900" (forexcrunch.com, 2020-08-11). Reported move: up, size not stated. Reason: risk reset seems to have favored the pullback moves. Quote: "risk reset seems to have favored the pullback moves" (source: aef8d4d3ecd6973c)
